metadata.title: Internet Aesthetics Stimulus Set and Feature Table (Nostalgia/Uncanny Computational Map)
metadata.description: A license-documented corpus of 681 images spanning internet aesthetics organized by affective operation on the past (restorative, hauntological, anemoia, inverted) plus present-day controls, with a computed 681x37 feature table (three perceptual axes + four phi coordinates), canonical-reference embeddings, the aesthetics catalogue, and full analysis code. Companion to the manuscript 'The Many Pasts of Internet Aesthetics'. All images openly licensed; per-image attribution in CREDITS.md.
metadata.notes: Individual images retain their own CC/public-domain licences; compilation is CC-BY-4.0.
